title: Mood Instability in Youth at High Risk for Bipolar Disorder.
abstract: Mood instability is associated with the onset of bipolar disorder (BD) in youth with a family history of the illness. In a clinical trial with youth at high risk for BD, we examined the association between mood instability and symptomatic, psychosocial, and familial functioning over an average of 2 years.
journal: Journal of the American Academy of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry
